script: Okay, listen. It's ten at night, the house is quiet, and you're scrolling. If that's you, I want to say something. Research keeps finding that divorced men are often lonelier than they admit. Not because something's wrong with you... but because, for many men, the circle gets smaller after a divorce. So here's one small step. Pick one person you haven't spoken to in a year, and send this: "Hey, I've been thinking of you. Coffee this week?" That's it. One message. And if it ever feels heavier than loneliness, please talk to someone you trust, or a professional. In the US, you can call or text nine eight eight. If you want fifty texts you can copy, comment TEXTS, and I'll send you my free cheat sheet.
hook_sub: Here's what many divorced men say.
